mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_fingerprint_switch_t (user_id, device_id, fingerprint_enabled, enabled_time, creator, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{fingerprintEnabled}, IF(#{fingerprintEnabled} = 1, NOW(), NULL), #{creator}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fingerprint_enabled = #{fingerprintEnabled}, enabled_time = IF(#{fingerprintEnabled} = 1 AND (enabled_time IS NULL OR fingerprint_enabled = 0), NOW(), enabled_time), modifier = #{creator}, update_time = NOW(), delete_flag = 0
